info.name: 03b-AutoDriverCancellationSilentWindow
info.description: Silent reallocation window: after a driver cancel the rider keeps seeing the old booking (flagged, phone hidden) for rider_config.silent_reallocation_window_seconds; the reallocation push is held until the window ends, skipped if another driver accepts or the rider cancels. Needs mock-server (SQL + Redis + FCM) and rider-app-scheduler running.
